source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Insert handler → anyToColumns → fieldValue.String() → json.Unmarshal(vector) → vectorArray []float32
source_grounding.note: Source code reveals that REST v2 API explicitly calls fieldValue.String() on line 530, then uses json.Unmarshal() on line 548 to parse BOTH string-formatted and array-formatted vectors into []float32. This is intentional design - the API accepts JSON strings like '[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]' OR JSON arrays like [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4] and unmarshals them identically. This is convenient client-side flexibility, not a bug.
